# Verify Current State

The verify function performs a shadow compile to check the consistency between the currently compiled state and the latest changes in the codebase. It identifies any divergences, ensuring the integrity of the compiled knowledge representation.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
